newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds mixed, cautious mood takes over.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds mixed, cautious mood takes over.

text.p: Argentine bonds were narrowly mixed late morning Thursday as the market adopted a cautious stance ahead of the release of important U.S. indicators next week.
"The market may be a little too high for next week's indicators -- some people will want to lighten their positions," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was down 1/4 at 90-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 rose $0.10 to 126.00.

Another trader said the market was set to return to watching U.S. indicators after the hefty gains Tuesday and Wednesday on the back of credit upgrades to several Argentine firms by Standard & Poor's.
He added that the market may be at vulnerably high levels if U.S. interest rate concerns rise again in coming sessions.
